item.title: The Cosmology Crisis: is our standard model of the universe breaking?
item.description: Two headlines keep running together: JWST found galaxies that shouldn’t exist, and our two measurements of the universe’s expansion refuse to agree. Same story, we’re told. They aren’t. One is already dead, one has survived ten years of attempts to kill it, and the one most likely to rewrite the textbook wasn’t in the headline at all. A five-minute read, no astronomy needed.
